question: Where can I get the results of renewable and storage auctions in Spain, with awarded projects, capacity (MW), price, technology and location?

answer.summary: Spain has held four REER (renewable) price auctions: 26-01-2021, 19-10-2021, 25-10-2022 and 22-11-2022 (none since). Each is resolved in a BOE resolution (PDF annex: awardee, CIF, technology, offer-unit code, EUR/MWh, kW), mirrored on MITECO. No storage auction has been held yet; no project location is published.
main_caveats: Latest REER auction is 22-11-2022; MITECO's REER page lists none after it. A new auction or the first capacity-market auction (storage eligible) would add a BOE resolution not yet in this card.
Annex units: kW, dot as thousands separator (10 = 10 kW, not 10 MW). Sum of Jan 2021 annex = 3,034.178 MW; Oct 2021 = 3,123.77 MW; Oct 2022 = 177 MW; Nov 2022 = 45.5 MW.
Awarded capacity is not installed capacity: awardees later register installations; the BOE rows are bids per awardee (CIF + UA code), so no plant name or site can be read from them.
Storage: not auctioned in REER; MITECO/IDAE storage awards are grants (PINALM, 126 projects, 818.3 M EUR) and access-capacity tenders, which are not price auctions.
CNMC supervision reports black out bidder volumes ([CONFIDENCIAL]); only awarded totals and weighted prices are readable.
answer.confidence_reason: Results and prices verified in downloaded BOE PDFs and CNMC reports; location/storage negatives rest on opened pages, but ERIDE/REPRO and OMIE could not be read (login, 403).

attributes.note: Rows are awardee offer units, not named plants; per-awardee strategic-plan PDFs exist but name no site. Installation identification goes to DGPEM unpublished.
attributes.gap_note: Orden TED/1161/2020 art.14 sends installation name/location to DGPEM electronically; no public list found in BOE, MITECO auction pages, CNMC, OMIE (403) or REPRO/ERIDE (login).

attributes.note: Annex column is in kW with dot thousands separator (50.800 = 50.8 MW; 10 = 10 kW).
EUR/MWh per offer unit in BOE annex (pay-as-bid); CNMC gives weighted averages. 2016-17 auctions have no price column.
Technology + RD 413/2014 subgroup (b.1.1 PV, b.2.1 onshore wind, b.6 biomass) per row.
No REER result or registry resolution carries province, municipality or coordinates (checked 9 BOE resolutions, 3 awardee plans).
attributes.gap_note: Looked in BOE results and preassignment annexes, MITECO auction pages, plans PDFs, CNMC reports; only Canary-wind 2015 call lists island per project (source 5).

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL --max-time 60 -o r1.pdf https://www.boe.es/boe/dias/2021/01/28/pdfs/BOE-A-2021-1251.pdf && pdftotext -layout r1.pdf r1.txt && python3 -I -c "import re; rows=[re.search(r'^\s*(.+?)\s{2,}([A-Z]\d{8})\s+(Fotovoltaica|Eólica terrestre)\.\s+(\S+)\s+(UA_\d+_\d+_\d+)\s+([\d,]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*$',l) for l in open('r1.txt',encoding='utf-8')]; rows=[m.groups() for m in rows if m]; print(len(rows), sum(int(r[6].replace('.',''))/1000 for r in rows)); print(rows[0])"
steps: Open https://www.miteco.gob.es/es/energia/renovables/regimen-economico.html, pick the auction page and take the 'Resolución ... por la que se resuelve' PDF (also at boe.es).
Run pdftotext -layout; table rows start after 'ANEXO I'. Parse with a regex on UA_yy_mm_nnnnn; price uses decimal comma, kW uses dot thousands.

Rows whose company name wraps onto a second line still match because the CIF, technology, UA, price and kW sit on the first line; the second name line must be joined by hand if the full name is needed.
Convert kW to MW (/1000) and compare the sum with CNMC totals (source 3) to check extraction: 3,034.178 / 3,123.770 / 177.000 / 45.500 MW.
Join to the preassignment resolutions (source 2) on the UA code for PER code, preassigned min/max energy and registered power.
reading_traps: kW with dot thousands: '10' and '5' (RIOS RENOVABLES, ENERGY INVESTMENT AND CONSULTANCY rows in the 1st auction) are 10 kW and 5 kW, not MW.
The 1st-auction annex has 109 UA rows for 32 awardees; 'awarded projects' are companies' bid blocks, not plants.
Oct 2021 technology label is 'Eólica Terrestre' (capital T) and the PV label has no trailing dot, unlike the Jan 2021 file.
Column set differs by auction: the 3rd adds Producto and Reserva minima por especificidad (biomass vs local distributed PV).
Parque Eolico Escepar and Parque Eolico Peralejo appear as PV awardees (hybridisation of wind farms), so company name does not imply technology.

if_unstructured.location_method: Neither result nor preassignment resolutions contain a site. Under Orden TED/1161/2020 art. 14 the awardee identifies installations (name, location, power) to DGPEM electronically within six months; no public list of those identifications was found. DGPEM authorisation resolutions in BOE do give municipalities per promoter (BOE-A-2024-7243, Cuenca), but that document does not cite the auction, and its 29.42 MW is not the 28.8 MW awarded to the same company, so linking them is unconfirmed.
cross_with: BOE authorisation and environmental resolutions searched by promoter name (link to an auction award unconfirmed unless the text cites the auction).
CNMC supervision reports for totals and weighted prices.
Catastro / PNOA services in country_basics once a site is known from another document.
